name: Cloudflare Computer
description: Gives agents on Cloudflare Workers a durable SQLite-backed filesystem in a Durable Object, with shell, JavaScript, and container execution backends, git, and AI SDK tools.

skills.name: Workspace Filesystem
skills.description: Reads, writes, lists, greps, and removes files in a virtual filesystem stored in Durable Object SQLite.

skills.name: Runtime Exec
skills.description: Runs shell commands or ECMAScript modules against the workspace through container, Worker shell, or Worker JavaScript backends.

skills.name: Tools for Agents
skills.description: Exposes ready-made AI SDK tools such as read, grep, write, edit, delete, and exec over a workspace.

skills.name: Git
skills.description: Adds an opt-in typed git client backed by isomorphic-git that works on the workspace files.

skills.name: Interrupt and Resume
skills.description: Restarts or replays interrupted isolate JavaScript and pauses runs for answers with ctx.interrupt() (experimental).
